supplementalBreakdowns.basis: Final FY2024 CMS-64 reports total $612,391,730,046 of federal medical-assistance and administration share. California's $44,352,196,702 MCO row is further split into its exact regular and COVID federal-share components. Thirteen annual service rows remain above $10B because CMS does not publicly release category-of-service quarters or plan payments; they are labeled public annual disclosure ceilings rather than divided or prorated. This actual-expenditure source view remains $5,125,269,954 below the MTS cash row and is not added to it.
